data.title: Review web text-alignment parity fix

Verify the rebuilt committed engine contains current print center/right behavior, the Node probe fails against the prior engine and passes against this one, existing web/native goldens remain valid, the documentation is accurate, and fresh packed Frog Commando rendering is corrected. data.reason: Approved exact implementation commit 99ab1fa. Full just check passes. Fresh workspace-packed Frog Commando passes generic Node/WASM checks and boots in Chromium at 192x320 with 64 valid colors, no runtime/page error, advancing frames, and visibly centered title/card labels. BUILD.md accurately documents the regeneration and tripwire behavior.
